main_text.p: קלט Chal. Recipere se, Refugere aliquò, Numer. 35.6.in Jonath.
קליט Ch. Contractus. Plur. fœm. קליטן Contractæ, Lev. 21.20.in Jonath.

קלל Chald. Levari, levem, velocem, vilem esse vel fieri, vilescere: Minui, imminui. Aphel אקל Levare, allevare: Leve, vile reddere, vilipendere, spernere, contemnere, probris, ignominiâ afficere, Psal. 55.13. Jesa. 23.9. Ezech. 22.7. Esth. 2.5. Syr. Præt. אקלו Allevârunt, exonerârunt ex navi, Act. 27.38. Ex Ithpahel Præter. אינאתקוללו מיא An alleviatæ essent aquæ, Genes. 8.8. in Targ. Jonat. Pahel primâ geminatâ קלקל Corrumpere, perdere, pervertere, dissipare, irritum facere, conspurcare, fœdare, inquinare, infatuare, fatuum, stultum reddere. Variis verbis Hebraeis respondet. Ithpehal אתקלקל Vastari, corrumpi.

קליל קליל קליל קליל Chald. & Syr. Levis, Velox, Celer: Levis, Vilis: Parvus, Genes. 42.20. in Jonathane. Item Modicum, Paucum, Parum. Geminatum Syr. ڬڬ ڬڬ Parum, Parum, Joh. 6.7. Chald. קליל קליל Paulatim, Exod. 23.30. in Targ. Jon. כרקליל Vel minimo, momento sc. Propemodum, Fermè, Penè. ڬ ڬ Paullò post, Matth. 26.73.
Cùm parum in eo vi-veret anima ejus, Græcè ἡμιθανὴς, semimortuum

page.notes: Hebrew and Syriac words are printed in their own script; the transcription of the Syriac and some Hebrew vowel-pointed forms is approximate. The Greek word ἡμιθανής is approximate. Bottom of page has a faint, illegible marking, not transcribed.
